name: Price Value Type 3 Code
definition: Specifies a type of value of the price.

DISC.name: Discount
DISC.definition: Price expressed as a number of percentage points below par, for example, a discount price of 2.0% equals a price of 98 when par is 100.

PREM.name: Premium
PREM.definition: Price expressed as a number of percentage points above par, for example, a premium price of 2.0% equals a price of 102 when par is 100.

SPRE.name: Spread
SPRE.definition: Difference between a market maker's bid and asked price.

TEDP.name: TED Price
TEDP.definition: Price is expressed as Treasury Euro Dollar price.

TEDY.name: TED Yield
TEDY.definition: Price is expressed as Treasury Euro Dollar yield.

FICT.name: Fixed Cabinet Trade
FICT.definition: Cabinet trades are used to indicate prices that trade at a price lower than that available on an exchange and they can be fixed or variable (primarily used for listed futures and options).

VACT.name: Variable Cabinet Trade
VACT.definition: Cabinet trades are used to indicate prices that trade at a price lower than that available on an exchange and they can be fixed or variable (primarily used for listed futures and options).
